about.commitmentDesc: We are committed to data privacy, secure access, and building tools that actually match how schools work every day.
about.label: About Imboni
about.missionDesc: To simplify school life by connecting every stakeholder (students, teachers, parents, and boarding staff) on one clear and reliable platform.
about.quote: "A school runs on communication. Imboni makes sure that communication is clear, timely, and reaches the right people, every time."
about.serveDesc: Imboni is built for boarding schools that want to bring clarity, transparency, and efficiency to every part of school operations.
about.subtitle: Imboni was designed from the ground up for boarding schools, where students, teachers, parents, and residential staff all need to stay connected and informed every single day.
about.title: Built around your school community

boarding.label: Residential Life
boarding.point1: Dormitory welfare monitoring and daily check-ins
boarding.point2: Health record management and sick bay tracking
boarding.point3: Incident reports with parent notification workflow
boarding.point4: House-based student tracking across all boarding houses
boarding.point5: Direct communication channel between Matron and parents
boarding.point6: Structured weekly schedule for all boarding students
boarding.subtitle: Every boarding house, every student, every incident: tracked and communicated clearly between staff and parents.
boarding.title: Complete boarding school oversight
boarding.visualDesc: The Matron and Discipline portals give boarding staff complete oversight of residential life, from health records to house activities.

contact.label: Get In Touch
contact.subtitle: Have a question about accessing your portal, or need support with your school-issued credentials? Reach out to the school office and we'll assist you.
contact.title: We're here to help

cta.label: Get Started
cta.subtitle: Use your school-issued credentials to access your portal. Contact the school office if you need help.
cta.title: Ready to sign in?

features.analyticsDesc: A live picture of performance trends, attendance rates, and exam outcomes.
features.label: Platform Features
features.messagingDesc: Direct messaging between teachers, parents, and boarding staff, with no outside apps needed.
features.mobileDesc: Full experience on any device: phone, tablet, or desktop. No app install needed.
features.realtimeDesc: Results, attendance, and announcements update instantly across all portals.
features.secureDesc: Every user sees only what they need. School-issued credentials keep data private.
features.smartDesc: Important notices reach students, teachers, and parents simultaneously.
features.subtitle: Imboni handles the communication and record-keeping so staff can focus on students.
features.title: Built for how schools actually work

footer.brandDesc: A unified school management platform connecting students, teachers, parents, and boarding staff under one roof.

hero.subtitle: Imboni brings students, teachers, parents, and boarding staff together on one unified platform, keeping communication clear and school life running smoothly.

portals.disDesc: Track student conduct, manage boarding activities, dining schedules, and staff coordination.
portals.dosDesc: Full academic oversight: manage timetables, exam schedules, analytics, and school-wide announcements.
portals.label: Six Portals
portals.matronDesc: Monitor student health, manage dormitory welfare, record incidents, and liaise with parents.
portals.parentDesc: Stay informed about your child's academic progress, attendance, behaviour, and school communications.
portals.studentDesc: Access your timetable, results, assignments, attendance record, and school announcements, all in one place.
portals.subtitle: From classroom results to dormitory welfare, each stakeholder gets a purpose-built portal tailored to their daily responsibilities.
portals.teacherDesc: Manage classes, record results, track attendance, and communicate with students effortlessly.
portals.title: A dedicated view for every role
